name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen Kids' Sub-Atomic Turkey Sandwich or Plain Pasta vs. "Not So Little Chicken"
brandOrRestaurant: Pym Test Kitchen (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: not so little chicken sandwich dca
whyItWorks: While the viral "Not So Little Chicken Sandwich" has a giant deep-fried breaded cutlet and pickled cabbage slaw, Pym's Kids' menu offers a clean Sub-Atomic Turkey Sandwich on soft bread or plain butter/parmesan pasta.
prepOrOrderInstructions: On sensitive days, order the Kids' Sub-Atomic Turkey Sandwich or Pasta (sauce on the side); if ordering the Not So Little Chicken Sandwich in remission, ask for no slaw/pickles and peel off excess fried breading.
watchOuts: Do NOT eat the cutaneous Mandarin Orange pack included with Kids' Meals (citrus trigger)—swap for applesauce or potato bites
